').textContent=text;$('#loading').style.display=show?'grid':'none';}
async function loadSceneAssets(sceneId,requestedMode=mode){const scene=sceneById[sceneId];setLoading(true,`${SCENE_NAMES[sceneId]} 환경을 불러오는 중`,requestedMode==='equirect'?'4096×2048 파노라마를 준비합니다.':'1024×1024 큐브맵 6면을 준비합니다.');const t0=performance.now();try{if(requestedMode==='equirect'){const img=await imageLoad(scene.equirect.path);replaceTexture(0,img,true);}else{const keys=['px','nx','py','ny','pz','nz'];const imgs=await Promise.all(keys.map(k=>imageLoad(scene.cubemap[k].path)));imgs.forEach((img,i)=>replaceTexture(i+1,img,false));}assetLoadMs[requestedMode]=Math.round(performance.now()-t0);updateBenchmark();}catch(err){console.error(err);$('#errorText').textContent='360 이미지 파일을 불러오지 못했습니다. 잠시 후 새로고침해 주세요.';errorBox.classList.add('show');throw err;}finally{setLoading(false);}}
function currentStep(){return FLOW[stepIndex];}
function setMode(next,load=true){if(!['equirect','cubemap'].includes(next))return;mode=next;document.querySelectorAll('[data-mode]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.mode===mode));$('#benchMode').textContent=mode==='equirect'?'Equirectangular':'Cubemap';const url=new URL(location.href);url.searchParams.set('mode',mode);history.replaceState(null,'',url);if(load)return loadSceneAssets(currentSceneId,mode);}
async function enterScene(sceneId){currentSceneId=sceneId;const scene=sceneById[sceneId];$('#sceneChip').innerHTML=`<b>${String(MANIFEST.scenes.findIndex(s=>s.id===sceneId)+1).padStart(2,'0')}</b> ${SCENE_NAMES[sceneId]}`;await loadSceneAssets(sceneId,mode);const st=currentStep();yaw=st&&st.scene===sceneId?stTarget(st).yaw:0;pitch=st&&st.scene===sceneId?stTarget(st).pitch:0;fov=75*Math.PI/180;}
function stTarget(st=currentStep()){return sceneById[st.scene].targets[st.target];}
